samples.content:
<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <random>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const int INF = 1000000;
const string BAD = "VK";
const string STR = "VKA";

class C1 {
    istream& in;
    ostream& out;
    stringstream ss;
    bool eof;

    string nextToken() {
        string token;
        while (true) {
            if (ss >> token) return token;
            if (eof) return "";
            string line;
            if (!getline(in, line)) {
                eof = true;
                return "";
            }
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(line);
        }
    }

    int nextInt() {
        string token = nextToken();
        return stoi(token);
    }

    string prepare(const string& s) {
        string res;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (BAD.find(c) != string::npos) {
                res.push_back(c);
            } else {
                res.push_back('A');
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    string swap(const string& s, int i, int j) {
        if (s[i] == s[j]) return "";
        string buf = s;
        swap(buf[i], buf[j]);
        return buf;
    }

    int slow(const string& s) {
        string ps = prepare(s);
        unordered_map<string, int> dist;
        deque<string> q;
        q.push_back(ps);
        dist[ps] = 0;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            string cur = q.front();
            q.pop_front();
            int d = dist[cur];
            if (cur.find(BAD) == string::npos) {
                return d;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)cur.size() - 1; ++i) {
                string nxt = swap(cur, i, i + 1);
                if (!nxt.empty() && dist.find(nxt) == dist.end()) {
                    dist[nxt] = d + 1;
                    q.push_back(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
        return -1; // should not happen
    }

    int fast(const string& s) {
        string ps = prepare(s);
        int n = ps.size();
        vector<int> a(n);
        vector<vector<int>> pos(3, vector<int>(n));
        vector<int> sz(3, 0);
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> cntHere(3, vector<vector<int>>(n, vector<int>(3, 0)));
        vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            a[i] = STR.find(ps[i]);
            int c = a[i];
            cntHere[c][sz[c]] = pref[i];
            pos[c][sz[c]++] = i;
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i];
            pref[i + 1][c]++;
        }

        int sz0 = sz[0], sz1 = sz[1], sz2 = sz[2];
        int dim0 = sz0 + 1, dim1 = sz1 + 1, dim2 = sz2 + 1;
        int total = 2 * dim0 * dim1 * dim2;
        vector<int> dp(total, INF);

        auto idx = [&](int last, int j0, int j1, int j2) {
            return ((last * dim0 + j0) * dim1 + j1) * dim2 + j2;
        };

        dp[idx(0, 0, 0, 0)] = 0;
        int ans = INF;

        for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz0; ++j0) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz1; ++j1) {
                for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz2; ++j2) {
                    for (int last = 0; last < 2; ++last) {
                        int cur = dp[idx(last, j0, j1, j2)];
                        if (cur == INF) continue;
                        int idxSum = j0 + j1 + j2;
                        if (idxSum == n) {
                            ans = min(ans, cur);
                            continue;
                        }
                        // place 'V' (c=0)
                        if (j0 < sz0) {
                            int cost = max(j1 - cntHere[0][j0][1], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[0][j0][2], 0);
                            int& nxt = dp[idx(1, j0 + 1, j1, j2)];
                            nxt = min(nxt, cur + cost);
                        }
                        // place 'K' (c=1) only if last != 1 (i.e., last == 0)
                        if (j1 < sz1 && last == 0) {
                            int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[1][j1][0], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[1][j1][2], 0);
                            int& nxt = dp[idx(0, j0, j1 + 1, j2)];
                            nxt = min(nxt, cur + cost);
                        }
                        // place 'A' (c=2)
                        if (j2 < sz2) {
                            int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[2][j2][0], 0) + max(j1 - cntHere[2][j2][1], 0);
                            int& nxt = dp[idx(0, j0, j1, j2 + 1)];
                            nxt = min(nxt, cur + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    string genStr() {
        static mt19937 rng(random_device{}());
        int n = rng() % 15 + 1;
        string res;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            res.push_back(STR[rng() % 3]);
        }
        return res;
    }

    void stress() {
        for (int tst = 0;; ++tst) {
            string s = genStr();
            int f = fast(s);
            int sl = slow(s);
            if (f != sl) {
                cerr << s << endl;
                cerr << f << endl;
                cerr << sl << endl;
                throw logic_error("Mismatch");
            }
            cerr << tst << endl;
        }
    }

public:
    C1(istream& in, ostream& out) : in(in), out(out), eof(false) {}

    void submit() {
        nextInt(); // ignore first integer
        string s = nextToken();
        out << fast(s) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    C1 c1(cin, cout);
    c1.submit();
    return 0;
}
